title: Single local-algebra descent with the module diagram in an independent small universe
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder in Type u, F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u} a diagram of local rings with local transition maps, and c a colimit cocone with local components and local vertex. Assume every F(i) is essentially of finite type over Z [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. Let T be a local ring in Type u, with a local map τ from c.pt, and supply a localization presentation of T by a finitely presented c.pt-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let N be an abelian group in arbitrary Type v with T-module structure and a supplied s-by-t finite free cokernel presentation. There is a cutoff i₀ and a diagram of local stage rings over the tail, with the compatible local structure and cocone maps, essential finite type maps, ring and additive colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], stage modules with exactly s-by-t cokernel presentations and semilinear maps, and the transition and limit localization and module tensor comparison assertions of lem-weil-pbc-limit-module-essentially-finite-presentation-over-system. The additive diagram is in AddCommGrpCat.{v}, not AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}. All component and pure-tensor equations are specified verbatim by lean.statement. This is descent of one algebra and module, not a tower of two algebras.

source.place: Tags 00QV and 00QX, presentation constructions; Tag 00R7 first paragraph, presentation matrix and stage cokernels. Independent-universe transport is the explicit countability/Shrink argument below.

proof.text: Lift N to ULift in universe max u v, transport its module structure and the supplied cokernel equivalence along ULift.down, and apply [lem-weil-pbc-limit-module-essentially-finite-presentation-over-system]. Keep the resulting tail, stage rings, local maps, ring colimit and ring localization comparisons. No new ring construction is required.

Compose the stage essential finite type algebra structure with the supplied essential finite type structure over Z. Algebra.EssFiniteType.subalgebra is finite type, hence is a surjective image of MvPolynomial (Fin n) Z by Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''. Its coefficient map embeds it into a countable finitely supported function space. IsLocalization.mk'_surjective represents the localization by pairs, proving each stage ring countable. The specified cokernel presentation and the surjection from Fin t vectors prove each stage module countable. Countable.toSmall supplies Small in universe v. This includes zero ranks.

Construct E with objects Shrink in universe v and transition maps conjugated by Shrink.addEquiv. Its cocone to N is conjugated at the source by Shrink.linearEquiv and at the target by ULift.moduleEquiv. Cancellation proves functor laws, naturality and semilinearity. Lift E by AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor and use the additive equivalences to construct a natural isomorphism to D. IsColimit.precomposeHomEquiv and Cocone.ext transfer the original colimit to the lifted cocone; isColimitOfReflects applies because the lift functor is fully faithful. Transport finite generation through the inverse linear equivalence, compose the exact s-by-t presentations with it, and conjugate transition and limit tensor equivalences using LinearEquiv.baseChange. Their formulas follow from baseChange_tmul and the original formulas. Reassemble unchanged ring data with these module clauses.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00QV and 00QX via existing descent; F3 formalized countability and Shrink transport, using fully faithful ULift reflection for the additive colimit.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_limit_module_small_over_system
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    [∀ i : I, IsLocalRing (F.obj i)] [IsLocalRing c.pt]
    (hF : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), IsLocalHom (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom)
    (hFfinite : ∀ i, Algebra.EssFiniteType ℤ (F.obj i))
    (hcLocal : ∀ i : I, IsLocalHom (c.ι.app i).hom)
    (T : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsLocalRing T] (τ : c.pt →+* T) [IsLocalHom τ]
    (P : Type p) [CommRing P] [Algebra c.pt P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation c.pt P]
    (W : Submonoid P) (f : P →+* T)
    (hf : f.comp (algebraMap c.pt P) = τ)
    (hT : letI := f.toAlgebra; IsLocalization W T)
    (N : AddCommGrpCat.{v}) [Module T N]
    (s t : ℕ) (H : (Fin s → T) →ₗ[T] (Fin t → T))
    (hN : Nonempty (((Fin t → T) ⧸ LinearMap.range H) ≃ₗ[T] N)) :
    ∃ i₀ : I,
      ∃ (B : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (β : B ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj T),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk T β)) ∧
        ∃ (κ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, B.obj i →+* T),
          (∀ i, ∀ x : B.obj i, κ i x = (β.app i).hom x) ∧
          (∀ i, IsLocalRing (B.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, IsLocalHom (κ i)) ∧
          (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
            IsLocalHom (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom) ∧
          ∃ (τ₀ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, F.obj i.1 →+* B.obj i),
            (∀ i, IsLocalHom (τ₀ i)) ∧ (∀ i, (τ₀ i).EssFiniteType) ∧
            (∀ i, (κ i).comp (τ₀ i) = τ.comp (c.ι.app i.1).hom) ∧
            (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
              (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom.comp (τ₀ i) =
                (τ₀ j).comp (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom) ∧
            ∃ (D : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v})
              (δ : D ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj N),
              Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk N δ)) ∧
              ∃ (ν : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, D.obj i →+ N)
                (_ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, Module (B.obj i) (D.obj i)),
                (∀ i, ∀ x : D.obj i, ν i x = (δ.app i).hom x) ∧
                (∀ i, ∀ (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i), ν i (y • x) = κ i y • ν i x) ∧
                (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j)
                  (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
                  (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom (y • x) =
                    (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
                (∀ i, Module.Finite (B.obj i) (D.obj i)) ∧
                (∀ i, ∃ H₀ : (Fin s → B.obj i) →ₗ[B.obj i] (Fin t → B.obj i),
                  Nonempty (((Fin t → B.obj i) ⧸ LinearMap.range H₀) ≃ₗ[B.obj i] D.obj i)) ∧
                (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
                  letI := (τ₀ i).toAlgebra
                  letI := (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
                  (∃ φ : B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] F.obj j.1 →+* B.obj j,
                    (∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : F.obj j.1),
                      φ (x ⊗ₜ[F.obj i.1] y) =
                        (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom x * τ₀ j y) ∧
                    (letI := φ.toAlgebra
                     ∃ U : Submonoid (B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] F.obj j.1),
                       IsLocalization U (B.obj j))) ∧
                  (letI := (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
                   ∃ e : B.obj j ⊗[B.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[B.obj j] D.obj j,
                     ∀ (y : B.obj j) (x : D.obj i),
                       e (y ⊗ₜ[B.obj i] x) = y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x)) ∧
                (∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i},
                  letI := (τ₀ i).toAlgebra
                  letI : Algebra (F.obj i.1) c.pt := (c.ι.app i.1).hom.toAlgebra
                  (∃ φ : B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] c.pt →+* T,
                    (∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : c.pt),
                      φ (x ⊗ₜ[F.obj i.1] y) = κ i x * τ y) ∧
                    (letI := φ.toAlgebra
                     ∃ U : Submonoid (B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] c.pt), IsLocalization U T)) ∧
                  (letI := (κ i).toAlgebra
                   ∃ e : T ⊗[B.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[T] N,
                     ∀ (y : T) (x : D.obj i), e (y ⊗ₜ[B.obj i] x) = y • ν i x))
